title: Android: (Stack trace) SIGABRT [libc.so] abort
body:
### Tested versions

Reproducible in 4.7.2.stable

### System information

OnePlus Nord CE5, Android 16 (SDK 36)

### Issue description

As discussed on rocketchat, posting here for reference/tracking purposes.

Crash seen in Play Console "Crashes and ANRs" section.

Device: OnePlus OP613BL1 (OnePlus Nord CE5)
Android version: Android 16 (SDK 36)
Issue visibility: Foreground

`Thread Failed to set damage region on surface 0x<sanitized>, error=EGL_BAD_ACCESS`

```
*** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** *** ***
pid: 0, tid: 29413 >>> com.jdogcorp.unnamedspaceidle <<<

```

Quoting Akien from rocketchat:
```
For the 3rd crash, I see references to similar stacktraces on other projects like Flutter, sometimes mentioning text input widgets. But I wouldn't discount it as a non-Godot issue, to me it sounds like OpenGL/EGL got in a bad state and that can be due to stuff Godot does. Or how we set up the Android UI stuff natively. I'm not very knowledgeable there.
OnePlus Nord CE5 seems fairly recent and mid/upper range so that can't just be discarded as "phone too weak".
```
We do have some instances of LineEdits in the project.
